title: Expense tracker
goal: Turn the page into an expense tracker. The page has a text input with the placeholder "Description", a text input with the placeholder "Amount", a button labelled "Add expense", and the list of stored expenses, each shown as "DESCRIPTION: $AMOUNT". Amounts are whole numbers. Expenses are stored on the server as `Expense` nodes connected to root, with fields `description: str` and `amount: int`. Below the list the page shows the sum of all stored amounts as "Total spent: $N", which is "Total spent: $0" when there are no expenses. Clicking Add expense stores the expense, shows it in the list, updates the total and clears both inputs. Stored expenses and their total are shown when the page loads. You may remove the Ping button.
